source.name: Matangi Tonga: Ikale Tahi squad named for Nations Cup 2026
source.quote: Macron will become the official supplier of match kits and apparel for Tonga's men's and women's national teams.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The deal was announced in Bologna on 10 June 2026; Tonga Rugby Union's own LinkedIn post calls it a five-year partnership making Macron the official kit supplier of the Tonga national rugby team. The white Macron hero logo sits on the right chest of the red home shirt and on the white match shorts in Nations Cup match photos (Tonga v Zimbabwe, Denver, 4 July 2026, in the high-resolution Tonga Rugby Union photo used by talanoaotonga.to and in Matangi Tonga's 9 July match-report photo; Tonga v Portugal, Winnipeg, 18 July 2026, Canadian Press photo via Alamy). Those photos show no other logo anywhere on the shirt or shorts. The Matangi Tonga page blocks scripted access (403 to the source checker, WebDriver fingerprint), but it opened normally and the quote was confirmed on 2026-09-30.

summary: Nothing on the shirt but the maker's mark: the red Macron home shirt of the 'Ikale Tahi carries no commercial sponsor on the front, sleeves, upper back or match shorts. Every placement checked against Nations Cup 2026 match photos: Tonga v Zimbabwe (Denver, 4 July 2026, hi-res Tonga Rugby Union photo via talanoaotonga.to; Matangi Tonga's 9 July report photo) and Tonga v Portugal (Winnipeg, 18 July 2026, Canadian Press/Alamy). Sanitarium Weet-Bix became an official sponsor of Tonga Rugby Union in September 2025 (Matangi Tonga), but the deal is described as player-nutrition and grassroots support and no Weet-Bix logo is visible on the playing kit in those photos.
